# Meet the data

## The two inputs

| File | First column | Other columns |
|---|---|---|
| `data/airway/gene-counts.tsv` | `gene_id` (one unique gene per row) | One nonnegative integer count column per sample |
| `data/airway/sample-metadata.tsv` | `sample_id` (one unique sample per row) | `cell` and `dex` |

Export the input tables with `Rscript scripts/R/prepare_airway.R`. Inspect the metadata: `dex` values are `untrt` and `trt`, and each cell line has both conditions. The original package and study are identified in `data/airway/README.md`.

To inspect just the header and first few rows in R:

```r
head(read.delim("data/airway/gene-counts.tsv", check.names = FALSE)[, 1:4])
head(read.delim("data/airway/sample-metadata.tsv"))
```

Run those lines in an R console in the main project folder. Gene IDs are labels, not gene symbols unless the source annotation says so.
